_readme: S730 subject-title hunt (group html_c), 2026-11-25, under Sam's ask in session S730: the catalog's printed heading for each course subject code (ruling r-no-mid-on-a-stray-code-sam-2026-11-25). Round 3: runs 45625259489 and 45626788039 found the catalog lists courses and departments, with no subject heading; the course template the page fetches from app.coursedog.com defines a Subject code question. This read prints that question's definition, to see whether it carries a name for each code. No model call.

outside_hosts.app.coursedog.com: Hartnell's catalog vendor: the catalog's own scripts call it (hartnell_course_units.json).

questions.subjects: Each subject the catalog's course index lists, with its printed title and code.
questions.index_address: Where the catalog lists its course subjects, if the guessed address is wrong.
